mapper.sql: device.id, device.department_id, department.name AS department_name, device.device_code, device.name, device.credential_version, device.status, device.credential_issued_at, device.credential_tested_version, device.credential_tested_at, device.last_seen_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.device AS device JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = device.department_id ORDER BY department.name, device.name, device.id
SELECT FROM public.device AS device JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = device.department_id WHERE device.id = #{deviceId}

SELECT FROM public.device AS device JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = device.department_id WHERE device.id = #{deviceId} AND device.department_id = #{departmentId} FOR UPDATE OF device

INSERT INTO public.device ( department_id, device_code, name, credential_hash, credential_version, status, credential_issued_at ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, #{deviceCode}, #{name}, #{credentialHash}, 1, 'INACTIVE', #{issuedAt} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.device SET status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE id = #{deviceId} AND status = 'INACTIVE' AND credential_tested_version = credential_version AND credential_tested_at >= credential_issued_at
UPDATE public.device SET status = 'INACTIVE', credential_tested_version = NULL, credential_tested_at = NULL WHERE id = #{deviceId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE public.device SET credential_hash = #{credentialHash}, credential_version = credential_version + 1, status = 'INACTIVE', credential_issued_at = #{issuedAt}, credential_tested_version = NULL, credential_tested_at = NULL WHERE id = #{deviceId} AND status IN ('INACTIVE', 'ACTIVE')
UPDATE public.device SET status = 'REVOKED', credential_tested_version = NULL, credential_tested_at = NULL WHERE id = #{deviceId} AND status IN ('INACTIVE', 'ACTIVE')
